subject: Credential factory & perimeter auth handoff for FinAnvil onboarding
messages:
From: Joe Smith <joe.smith@finanvil.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Raman <priya.raman@finanvil.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: FinAnvil onboarding: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlists and service accounts

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the intro — we kick off the Redwood onboarding next week and want to align on the access controls portion early so our infra team can prepare. High level asks from FinAnvil:

- SSO (SAML) integration with our IdP (Okta)
- SCIM provisioning for user/org sync and mapping admin roles
- IP allowlist for management plane (we have static egress ranges)
- Service account patterns + least-privilege roles for automated jobs

I've attached our SAML metadata and a starter SCIM attribute map so you can confirm attribute names. Please reply with Redwood's recommended service account templates and any cluster-level ACLs we should expect.

Attachments: finanvil-saml-metadata.xml, finanvil-scim-map.xlsx

Also — we're sensitive to maintenance windows. Looking for a non-disruptive cutover (0:00–04:00 UTC windows preferred).

Joe Smith
Director, Platform Engineering
FinAnvil Inc
joe.smith@finanvil.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Joe Smith <joe.smith@finanvil.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinAnvil onboarding: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlists and service accounts

Joe — thanks for the clear list and the attachments, we received the SAML metadata and the SCIM starter map. High-level plan from our side (short checklist):

1) Security scoping call (30m) — confirm SAML attributes, SCIM group maps, and IP ranges.
2) Provide credential factory template (service-account request CSV) for your infra team to fill.
3) Test SAML with a staging IdP (we'll provide a test SP entity).
4) SCIM dry-run (provision a sandbox org + mapping verification).
5) Production cutover during preferred window with rollback steps.

Immediate asks for your infra team to unblock us: 
- Confirm static egress IP ranges for management endpoints (format: CIDR(s)).
- Confirm which SCIM attributes you need for role mapping (e.g., roles, dept, employeeType).
- Let us know if you require signed assertions & request encryption (we support both).

I'm attaching our credential-request-template.csv to make the service-account provisioning straightforward. Monica (CS) will run the implementation project and Jonas will own the IP allowlist verification and networking pre-check. Neha will be on the SCIM attribute mapping if any schema translation is required. Ben — looping you for commercial notes/any required change orders.

Attachments: credential-request-template.csv

Next steps: Monica will propose two slots for the security scoping call by EOD. If that works, we'll book and include runbook links.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Onboarding, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Joe Smith <joe.smith@finanvil.com>, Priya Raman <priya.raman@finanvil.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinAnvil onboarding: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlists and service accounts — scoping call options

Hi Joe / Priya —

Thanks Karthik. Quick note from CS — proposing two 30-minute slots for the security scoping call this week so we can capture requirements and record action items:

- Option A: Thu 2026-10-21 09:00 PT / 16:00 UTC
- Option B: Fri 2026-10-22 07:00 PT / 14:00 UTC

Agenda (30m):
- Confirm SAML binding (POST vs. Redirect) and assertion signing
- SCIM attribute map and group-to-role mapping template review
- IP allowlist CIDRs and temporary test IPs for validation
- Service account roles & expiration policy (credential factory defaults)
- Success criteria & rollback plan

Pre-read (shared): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1A2b3FinAnvil-Onboard
HubSpot playbook: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/4732

Please reply with preferred slot and your internal attendees. We'll send a calendar invite with the runbook and a recording link.

Best,

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Joe Smith <joe.smith@finanvil.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Raman <priya.raman@finanvil.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinAnvil onboarding: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlists and service accounts — scoping call options

On Tue, Oct 19, 2026 at 11:30 AM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Joe / Priya —
> 
> Thanks Karthik. Quick note from CS — proposing two 30-minute slots for the security scoping call this week so we can capture requirements and record action items:

Thanks — Option A (Thu 10/21 09:00 PT) works for our SRE lead and me. Attendees from FinAnvil: Joe Smith, Priya Raman (IAM), and Andrew Lee (SRE).

CIDR blocks for IP allowlist (management plane):
- 54.33.120.0/22
- 3.5.64.0/22

We require signed assertions and AES-256 encrypted response for SAML. SCIM required attributes: externalId, userName, emails[type=work], groups, title, department, employeeType. We attached a refined SCIM mapping in our original email — happy to review live.

One ask: if credential factory issues long-lived keys for service accounts, can you make TTL configurable per-request (we prefer short TTLs, e.g., 12h)? Also please confirm whether Redwood can rotate service account keys automatically on schedule.

See you Thursday — will fill out the credential CSV before the call.

Joe
Director, Platform Engineering
FinAnvil Inc
joe.smith@finanvil.com
